**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User has lived in suburban Los Angeles for about 4 years.
- [FACT] User moved from San Francisco for a job opportunity.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking to explore new social media analytics tools for campaigns.
- [CHANGE] User has used Hootsuite Insights before but hasn't tried other tools.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended social media analytics tools include Hootsuite Insights, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Audiense, Google Trends, local Facebook Groups, and Los Angeles-specific social media reports.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hootsuite Insights offers location-based filtering for tracking engagement, sentiment, and demographics specific to the LA area.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social provides in-depth audience insights, including demographics, interests, and behaviors, with location-based filtering.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Brandwatch offers advanced social media monitoring and analytics capabilities, including location-based filtering.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Audiense provides location-based insights, including audience demographics, interests, and behaviors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Trends can provide insights into what's currently popular in LA.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Local Facebook Groups can help gather insights into the target audience's interests and concerns.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested looking for reports on social media usage and trends in LA, such as the "Los Angeles Social Media Survey" by the Los Angeles County Economic Development Corporation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considering demographics, interests, behaviors, sentiment, and influencers when using the tools.
- [FACT] User is considering Sprout Social's Pro plan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social's Pro plan pricing is $149/month (billed annually) or $179/month (billed monthly) for 10 social profiles and 3 users.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social's pricing is slightly higher than Hootsuite, but offers more comprehensive analytics and personalized customer support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social offers a dedicated onboarding specialist, interactive tutorials, and a customized onboarding plan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social provides 24/7 email support, phone support during business hours, live chat, and access to Sprout Social University for training.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sprout Social's reporting features include cross-channel reporting, customizable dashboards, performance metrics, content performance analysis, audience insights, and competitor analysis.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Performance metrics tracked by Sprout Social include engagement, reach, sentiment, and conversion.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Content performance analysis includes post-level metrics, content type analysis, and identification of top-performing content.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Audience insights
